name: Takanashi Remi
source:
Her surname was formerly Toujou, she is the younger sister of [url=/c20243]Toujou Haruka[/url].

She is the mother of [url=/c26057]Takanashi Remon[/url].

The new surname she shares with [url=/c20242]Takanashi Chihiro[/url] is due to marrying [url=/c38317]Takanashi Hiroaki[/url].
